purpose: Validate FoldX 5.1 (Windows binary, WSL interop) end-to-end on human OPRM1 before any re-ranking experiment. Closes the KL1 license blocker if kept.

tool.name: FoldX
tool.distribution: foldx5_Windows.zip provided by user after manual academic registration at foldxsuite.crg.eu
tool.provenance_note: Registration completed manually by @user (Cristobal) with a Registration Purpose text declaring non-commercial academic benchmarking of ESM3-generated OPRM1 variants for an open preprint.
tool.execution_mode: PE32+ Windows binary run from /mnt/c/temp/foldx5 via WSL interop; rotabase.txt and molecules/ present in distribution
tool.individual_list_format: <wt_1letter><chain><pos><mut_1letter>;  e.g. AR113F; (WT FIRST, then chain letter, then position, then mutant)

structure.pdb: oprm1_R.pdb (OPRM1 chain R, from ddg_work/, cryo-EM 8EFO lineage)

ddg_A113F_foldx.units: kcal/mol (FoldX Dif total energy, positive = destabilizing)
ddg_A113F_foldx.interpretation: Two independent force fields (EvoEF2 rigid-backbone, FoldX 5.1 flexible side-chain) agree in sign and catastrophe magnitude on the buried Ala113->Phe overpacking site. The steric mechanism in ddg_repack_floor_and_steric_mechanism_v1 is not an EvoEF2 artifact.

self_mutation_noise_floor_foldx.interpretation: FoldX self-mutations return ~0.000 kcal/mol (max |ddG| = 0.05). The repack noise floor measured in EvoEF2 (mean -0.75, max 2.78) is ABSENT in FoldX's default side-chain relaxation: FoldX re-optimizes side chains symmetrically for mutant and WT-like reference, so its floor is not comparable to EvoEF2's. Any cross-FF comparison must declare this.

errors_found_and_fixed_during_smoke: First BuildModel attempt never created individual_list.txt (600 s foreground timeout killed the command that would have written it); 7 subsequent 'No mutation file is provided' failures were caused by the missing file, not the tool.
Mutation syntax: WT one-letter code comes FIRST, then chain, then position, then mutant (AR113F, not RA113F). 'RA113F' reads as WT=Arg chain=A which does not exist.
Mutant file MUST be named individual_list* or mutant_file* (binary enforces filename prefix).
CLI --mutant-file=... works once the file exists with a valid name and correct syntax; config-file route parses but BuildModel does not consume it in this build.
what_this_does_NOT_show: No claim about ESM3 generation quality — no variants generated yet.
No claim about fibromyalgia or OPRM1 as a therapeutic target.
One mutation + 5 self-mutations is a smoke test, not a benchmark. The 133-position battery is not re-run.
FoldX ddG values are not comparable in absolute terms to EvoEF2 ddG (different force fields, different entropy terms, different reference states).
license: Academic license activated by user registration. Binary hash above identifies the exact build used.
next_steps_pre_registered: If pivote approved: re-run ddg battery (133 unique positions, 3 arms) under FoldX 5.1 as flexible-side-chain axis; paired Wilcoxon, n=133, pre-registered alpha=0.05, two-sided; report both raw and |ddG|<=10 trimmed.
ESM3 variants from Colab (spec esm3_oprm1_v3) can be scored under BOTH EvoEF2 and FoldX for cross-FF robustness.
Vina docking (8QY on 8EFO) remains conditional on a positive ddG result, per spec v3.
process_trace: Binary extracted to /mnt/c/temp/foldx5 (WSL interop; UNC cwd avoided)
RepairPDB on oprm1_R.pdb: 119.42 s, total energy -0.44
hash_method: sha256 over file bytes (binary and PDB); JSON has no self-hash until registered in run store
natural_friction: FoldX is Windows-first in this distribution; WSL interop adds ~0 latency for CLI but RepairPDB is slow (2 min) because it runs through the 9P filesystem bridge. Batch scoring of 400 mutations should copy the working set to the Windows-native path once and keep FoldX I/O there.
